# The Next Founder

> The Next Founder is a platform and TV format by House of Founders. Ventures that were thought up, built and tested at House of Founders look for a founder to run them; partners fund the first phase in tranches released per milestone. Candidates apply in a video conversation with Eva, an AI interviewer, get a score and feedback, and the best pitch on the show, where investors compete for the founder.

The site is in Dutch (default) and English. Seven ventures come from House of Founders; ten are examples for the prototype. Tranche amounts are examples. The app is a scripted prototype.

## Ventures

- [Exit Buddy](/en/ventures/exit-buddy/): Finds the right adviser for selling your business.
- [APK Opa](/en/ventures/apk-opa/): Retired mechanics inspect a used car before you buy it.
- [Whoop Dog](/en/ventures/whoop-dog/): A tracker that measures how your dog sleeps and recovers.
- [Eitje](/en/ventures/eitje/): A fertility check for women.
- [Zonde](/en/ventures/zonde/): Helps households once their solar panels stop paying off.
- [Biedmeester](/en/ventures/biedmeester/): An AI that watches, explains and adjusts the Google Ads of several clients.
- [Vaste Prik](/en/ventures/vaste-prik/): Digital loyalty cards in Apple and Google Wallet, no app needed.
- [Fietsdokter](/en/ventures/fietsdokter/): A bike mechanic who comes to your home or office, on subscription. (example)
- [Klusbieb](/en/ventures/klusbieb/): Borrow tools from your neighbours, by the day. (example)
- [Oogstrijk](/en/ventures/oogstrijk/): Farm surplus straight to restaurants. (example)
- [Stille Uren](/en/ventures/stille-uren/): Book a quiet seat in a café, by the hour. (example)
- [Kinderkast](/en/ventures/kinderkast/): A clothing subscription for kids, second hand and growing with them. (example)
- [Pensioenpraat](/en/ventures/pensioenpraat/): Explains to freelancers in five minutes what to do about their pension. (example)
- [Beweegmaatje](/en/ventures/beweegmaatje/): Matches older people with a walking buddy nearby. (example)
- [Bouwlog](/en/ventures/bouwlog/): A digital site diary for contractors, dictated on site. (example)
- [Zorgrooster](/en/ventures/zorgrooster/): An AI that builds rosters for home care. (example)
- [Bakdeel](/en/ventures/bakdeel/): Share a cargo bike with your street. (example)
